Description: The `getLocationBOLA` endpoint returns vehicle location for any `carId` (UUID) without checking if the requesting user owns the vehicle. This allows tracking any user's vehicle.

The `convertVideo` method executes a shell command using `BashCommand` with user-supplied parameters (`conversion_params`) injected directly into the command string. This allows Remote Code Execution (RCE) if shell injection is enabled.
The `ValidateCoupon` endpoint unmarshals the entire JSON body into a `bson.M` map and passes it directly to a MongoDB query. Attackers can inject MongoDB operators (e.g., `$ne`) to bypass validation.

The `FindAuthorByEmail` function sets package-level global variables (`autherID`, `nickname`, etc.) for request-scoped user data. In a concurrent environment, this Race Condition allows users to assume the identity of other users processing requests simultaneously.
The `JwtProvider` allows the usage of the public RSA key as an HMAC secret when the algorithm is set to `HS256`. This is a JWT Algorithm Confusion vulnerability allowing signature bypass.
The `ApplyCouponView` constructs a raw SQL query using string concatenation with the user-supplied `coupon_code`, leading to SQL Injection.
The `OrderControlView` retrieves an order by `order_id` and returns full details (including user info) without verifying if the requesting user owns the order.
The `checkOtp` endpoint allows unlimited attempts to verify a 4-digit OTP. The counter is incremented but never blocks the user or invalidates the OTP effectively.

The `ContactMechanicView` accepts an arbitrary URL in `mechanic_api` and performs a GET request to it without validation. This allows Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) and potential internal network scanning.

The `UserServiceRequestsView` exposes service requests by VIN via the URL `service_requests/(?P<vin>[^/]+)$` without any authentication decorator (`@jwt_auth_required`) or ownership check. Anyone can read any vehicle's service history.
Short Title: Unauthenticated Access / BOLA in Service Requests

Description: The Chatbot service gives the LLM agent a `SQLDatabaseToolkit` connected as `admin` to the main `postgresdb`. A user can use Prompt Injection to read or modify sensitive database tables via the Chatbot.
The `GetReportView` fetches service reports using `report_id` without verifying if the user is the vehicle owner or the assigned mechanic.
The `deleteVideoBOLA` endpoint is intended for admins but only checks for authentication, not the `ADMIN` role. This is a Broken Function Level Authorization (BFLA).
The `JwtProvider` trusts the `jku` (JSON Key URL) header in the JWT to fetch the verification key. An attacker can host a key and sign their own tokens if they can reach the URL.
The `convertVideo` endpoint allows triggering video conversion for any `video_id` provided by the user, without checking ownership.
The `loginWithToken` endpoint allows login via an email token. If tokens are predictable or leaked, it bypasses password authentication.
